additional_info.subject: RE: ID0457619-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312569868/06] Charging center LEM DC Meter error CRM:03056000303
additional_info.body:
Dear Bastien,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support team in regards of ticket
ID0457619.
The ticket was opened from your side for LEM DC meter error on charger
X0Inqs
, which resulted in a StopSession via Backend, even if the charge continued.
I analyzed the logs at the timestamp you provided, and these are my findings:
At 2025-10-21T07:51:01 DC2 is connected
Immediately, there is a LEM error:
2025-10-21T07:51:01.600856+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/f6d50f388563[640]: Error on LEM DC Meter (meter id: 1220890208 status: {"value":81,"bits":{"suLinkStatusIsOk":true,"muFatalErrorOccured":false,"transactionIsOnGoing":false,"tamperingIsDetected":false,"timeSyncStatusIsOk":true,"overTemperatureIsDetected":false,"reversedVoltage":true,"suMeasureFailureOccurred":false}}
This faulted situation is communicated to the Backend:
2025-10-21T07:51:02.603922+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/f6d50f388563[640]: OCPP: Send command: StatusNotification (11984d7f-8d6f-469d-8fa3-71905de66ac2) - {"connectorId":2,"errorCode":"PowerMeterFailure","status":"Faulted","info":"Error on LEM DC Meter (meter id: 1220890208 status"}
At the same time, the LEM communicates to work:
2025-10-21T07:51:02.853137+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/f6d50f388563[640]: LEM DC Meter for outlet (id: 2) is working
Therefore, a preparing status is sent to the Backend:
2025-10-21T07:51:03.855787+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/f6d50f388563[640]: OCPP: Send command: StatusNotification (9beb4813-e8cf-4cc4-b022-3ecbb2d16ff4) - {"connectorId":2,"errorCode":"NoError","status":"Preparing"}
As you described, the session starts, after a few seconds a "StopTransaction" is sent to the Backend and it is accepted, but the charging session goes on.
The one described above is unfortunately a known situation, where the charger cannot properly handle a LEM error, and the SECC is not actually stopping the session when sending an OCPP StopTransaction. Being the charger on FW v6.1.3, this behavior is not really visible, only by the " Error on LEM DC Meter" log line. Starting from FW v7.0.5, this error is more visible in the logs, and the correlation between LEM error and missed charging stop form EcoG.
In conclusion, this is a known bug, and it will be fixed in the upcoming
FW v8.1.X
, which is currently in Beta testing, and expected to be released by CW47. In order to avoid this situation to repeat, I would recommend to update the charger to
v8.1.X
as soon as it is released.
In the meanwhile, I would recommend:
To update the charger to v8.0.5, to have a better logging and to install the best FW right now available. If you provide me with confirmation, I can proceed with the update on my end.
If possible, to perform an Hardware reboot directly from the charger. This LEM error has proven to have a random occurrence, and a Hardware reboot has proven to temporarily restore the charger and reduce the frequency of LEM error.
Since a solution for this type of error is already addressed, if you agree I would proceed to close this ticket since no further action from service is required. Our colleagues from France region will inform you once the FW v8.1.X will be released.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you soon!
Thank you.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
